subject: ddl: Fix Global Index consistency during some ALTER PARTITION states. (#64018)
summary: Reviewed the diff vs first parent with focus on DDL/global-index metadata & state-machine behavior. `pkg/table/tables/index.go` switches global-index key table-ID selection to be driven by `PartitionInfo.DDLChangedIndex` (with a nil guard on `PartitionInfo`) instead of `idxInfo.State != StatePublic`, preventing old/new index copies from accidentally switching keyspace when `NewTableID` is set during ALTER PARTITION. `pkg/ddl/index.go` cleanup now batch-reads unique global-index entries and skips deletion when the decoded partition ID doesn’t match the partition being scanned (avoids deleting entries already overwritten to another partition); it also locks the key before delete. No remaining Blocker/High correctness, consistency, compatibility, or concurrency issues found. Later history up to `upstream/master` shows no follow-up commits modifying these specific hunks.
